# Part 1: Add Chr_ChrPos_Pheno Key and Prepare Data

```{r add-key}
add_key <- function(df) {
  df$Chr_ChrPos_Pheno <- paste0(df$Chr, "_", df$ChrPos, "_", df$Pheno)
  df
}

# Add keys to all dataframes
all_snps_eqtl_FLU.1  <- add_key(all_snps_eqtl_FLU.1)
all_CNV_eqtl_FLU.1   <- add_key(all_CNV_eqtl_FLU.1)
all_indel_eqtl_FLU.1 <- add_key(all_indel_eqtl_FLU.1)
all_SV_eqtl_FLU.1    <- add_key(all_SV_eqtl_FLU.1)

all_snps_eqtl_FLU.2  <- add_key(all_snps_eqtl_FLU.2)
all_CNV_eqtl_FLU.2   <- add_key(all_CNV_eqtl_FLU.2)
all_indel_eqtl_FLU.2 <- add_key(all_indel_eqtl_FLU.2)
all_SV_eqtl_FLU.2    <- add_key(all_SV_eqtl_FLU.2)

# Merge all variant types per dataset
all_eqtl_FLU.1 <- bind_rows(
  mutate(all_snps_eqtl_FLU.1,  variant_type = "SNPs"),
  mutate(all_CNV_eqtl_FLU.1,   variant_type = "CNVs"),
  mutate(all_indel_eqtl_FLU.1, variant_type = "InDels"),
  mutate(all_SV_eqtl_FLU.1,    variant_type = "SVs")
)

all_eqtl_FLU.2 <- bind_rows(
  mutate(all_snps_eqtl_FLU.2,  variant_type = "SNPs"),
  mutate(all_CNV_eqtl_FLU.2,   variant_type = "CNVs"),
  mutate(all_indel_eqtl_FLU.2, variant_type = "InDels"),
  mutate(all_SV_eqtl_FLU.2,    variant_type = "SVs")
)

cat("YPD.1 total eQTLs (all variant types):", nrow(all_eqtl_FLU.1), "\n")
cat("YPD.2 total eQTLs (all variant types):", nrow(all_eqtl_FLU.2), "\n\n")
```

# Part 2: Build Unified Dataframes (for detailed reproducibility analysis)

```{r build-unified}
build_unified <- function(df1, df2, variant_label) {
  
  # Prepare YPD.1
  d1 <- df1 %>%
    mutate(
      FLU.1_neglog10p              = -log10(PValue),
      FLU.1_thr_neglog10p          = -log10(thr_perm),
      FLU.1_distance_above_thr     = FLU.1_neglog10p - FLU.1_thr_neglog10p
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr_ChrPos_Pheno, Pheno, Chr, ChrPos,
                  FLU.1_neglog10p, FLU.1_thr_neglog10p,
                  FLU.1_distance_above_thr,
                  FLU.1_SnpWeight = SnpWeight)

  # Prepare YPD.2
  d2 <- df2 %>%
    mutate(
      FLU.2_neglog10p              = -log10(PValue),
      FLU.2_thr_neglog10p          = -log10(thr_perm),
      FLU.2_distance_above_thr     = FLU.2_neglog10p - FLU.2_thr_neglog10p
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr_ChrPos_Pheno, Pheno, Chr, ChrPos,
                  FLU.2_neglog10p, FLU.2_thr_neglog10p,
                  FLU.2_distance_above_thr,
                  FLU.2_SnpWeight = SnpWeight)

  ids1 <- d1$Chr_ChrPos_Pheno
  ids2 <- d2$Chr_ChrPos_Pheno

  # Start with ALL YPD.2 eQTLs, mark shared
  unified <- d2 %>%
    mutate(
      In_FLU.1  = Chr_ChrPos_Pheno %in% ids1,
      Category = ifelse(In_FLU.1, "SHARED", "FLU.2_ONLY"),
      Variant  = variant_label
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      d1 %>% dplyr::select(Chr_ChrPos_Pheno, FLU.1_neglog10p,
                            FLU.1_thr_neglog10p, FLU.1_distance_above_thr,
                            FLU.1_SnpWeight),
      by = "Chr_ChrPos_Pheno"
    )

  # YPD.1-only eQTLs
  FLU.1_only <- d1 %>%
    filter(!Chr_ChrPos_Pheno %in% ids2) %>%
    mutate(
      Category                = "FLU.1_ONLY",
      In_FLU.1                 = TRUE,
      Variant                 = variant_label,
      FLU.2_neglog10p          = NA,
      FLU.2_thr_neglog10p      = NA,
      FLU.2_distance_above_thr = NA,
      FLU.2_SnpWeight          = NA
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr_ChrPos_Pheno, Pheno, Chr, ChrPos,
                  FLU.2_neglog10p, FLU.2_thr_neglog10p,
                  FLU.2_distance_above_thr, FLU.2_SnpWeight,
                  FLU.1_neglog10p, FLU.1_thr_neglog10p,
                  FLU.1_distance_above_thr, FLU.1_SnpWeight,
                  Category, In_FLU.1, Variant)

  bind_rows(unified, FLU.1_only)
}

# Build unified dataframes for each variant type
unified_snp   <- build_unified(all_snps_eqtl_FLU.1,  all_snps_eqtl_FLU.2,  "SNPs")
unified_cnv   <- build_unified(all_CNV_eqtl_FLU.1,   all_CNV_eqtl_FLU.2,   "CNVs")
unified_indel <- build_unified(all_indel_eqtl_FLU.1, all_indel_eqtl_FLU.2, "InDels")
unified_sv    <- build_unified(all_SV_eqtl_FLU.1,    all_SV_eqtl_FLU.2,    "SVs")

# Combine all for overall analysis
unified_all <- bind_rows(unified_snp, unified_cnv, unified_indel, unified_sv) %>%
  mutate(Variant = factor(Variant, levels = c("SNPs", "CNVs", "InDels", "SVs")))

cat("✓ Unified dataframes built\n\n")
```

# Part 4: Detailed Reproducibility Statistics

```{r reproducibility-stats}
cat("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DETAILED REPRODUCIBILITY ANALYSIS\n")
cat("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

summarise_unified <- function(ud, variant_label) {

  shared_df   <- ud %>% filter(Category == "SHARED")
  FLU.1only_df <- ud %>% filter(Category == "FLU.1_ONLY")
  FLU.2only_df <- ud %>% filter(Category == "FLU.2_ONLY")

  cat("\n", strrep("─", 60), "\n")
  cat(variant_label, "\n")
  cat(strrep("─", 60), "\n")

  cat("\nSHARED (n =", nrow(shared_df), "):\n")
  cat("  YPD.1 -log10(p): mean =", round(mean(shared_df$FLU.1_neglog10p, na.rm=T), 3),
      "| median =", round(median(shared_df$FLU.1_neglog10p, na.rm=T), 3), "\n")
  cat("  YPD.2 -log10(p): mean =", round(mean(shared_df$FLU.2_neglog10p, na.rm=T), 3),
      "| median =", round(median(shared_df$FLU.2_neglog10p, na.rm=T), 3), "\n")
  cat("  YPD.1 dist above thr: mean =", round(mean(shared_df$FLU.1_distance_above_thr, na.rm=T), 3), "\n")
  cat("  YPD.2 dist above thr: mean =", round(mean(shared_df$FLU.2_distance_above_thr, na.rm=T), 3), "\n")

  # Pearson correlation of -log10(p) for shared
  sc <- shared_df %>% filter(!is.na(FLU.1_neglog10p) & !is.na(FLU.2_neglog10p))
  if (nrow(sc) > 2) {
    ct <- cor.test(sc$FLU.1_neglog10p, sc$FLU.2_neglog10p, method = "pearson")
    cat("  Pearson r (-log10p): r =", round(ct$estimate, 4),
        "| p =", format(ct$p.value, scientific = TRUE), "\n")
  }

  # Pearson correlation of effect sizes for shared
  sc_beta <- shared_df %>% filter(!is.na(FLU.1_SnpWeight) & !is.na(FLU.2_SnpWeight))
  if (nrow(sc_beta) > 2) {
    ct_beta <- cor.test(sc_beta$FLU.1_SnpWeight, sc_beta$FLU.2_SnpWeight, method = "pearson")
    cat("  Pearson r (SnpWeight): r =", round(ct_beta$estimate, 4),
        "| p =", format(ct_beta$p.value, scientific = TRUE), "\n")
  }

  cat("\nYPD.1-ONLY (n =", nrow(FLU.1only_df), "):\n")
  cat("  YPD.1 -log10(p): mean =", round(mean(FLU.1only_df$FLU.1_neglog10p, na.rm=T), 3),
      "| median =", round(median(FLU.1only_df$FLU.1_neglog10p, na.rm=T), 3), "\n")

  cat("\nYPD.2-ONLY (n =", nrow(FLU.2only_df), "):\n")
  cat("  YPD.2 -log10(p): mean =", round(mean(FLU.2only_df$FLU.2_neglog10p, na.rm=T), 3),
      "| median =", round(median(FLU.2only_df$FLU.2_neglog10p, na.rm=T), 3), "\n")
}

summarise_unified(unified_snp,   "SNPs")
summarise_unified(unified_cnv,   "CNVs")
summarise_unified(unified_indel, "InDels")
summarise_unified(unified_sv,    "SVs")
summarise_unified(unified_all,   "All variants combined")
```

# Part 6: Bar Plot — Total eQTLs per Variant Type

```{r fig-total-counts, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
count_df <- data.frame(
  Dataset      = rep(c("YPD.1", "YPD.2"), 4),
  Variant_type = c("SNPs", "SNPs", "CNVs", "CNVs", "InDels", "InDels", "SVs", "SVs"),
  Count        = c(
    nrow(all_snps_eqtl_FLU.1),  nrow(all_snps_eqtl_FLU.2),
    nrow(all_CNV_eqtl_FLU.1),   nrow(all_CNV_eqtl_FLU.2),
    nrow(all_indel_eqtl_FLU.1), nrow(all_indel_eqtl_FLU.2),
    nrow(all_SV_eqtl_FLU.1),    nrow(all_SV_eqtl_FLU.2)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Variant_type = factor(Variant_type, levels = c("SNPs", "CNVs", "InDels", "SVs")),
    Dataset      = factor(Dataset, levels = c("YPD.1", "YPD.2"))
  )

dataset_colors <- c("YPD.1" = "#E76F51", "YPD.2" = "#2196ac")

p_counts <- ggplot(count_df, aes(x = Dataset, y = Count, fill = Dataset)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(Count)), vjust = -0.4, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dataset_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  facet_wrap(~ Variant_type, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  labs(y = "Number of significant eQTLs", 
       title = "Total eQTL counts by variant type") +
  pub_theme +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

print(p_counts)

ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Fig1_total_eQTL_counts.tiff"),
       p_counts, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
cat("✓ Saved: Fig1_total_eQTL_counts.tiff\n")
```

```{r fig-shared-unique, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
                  sum(unified_indel$Category == "FLU.2_ONLY"),
                  sum(unified_indel$Category == "SHARED"))
  ),
  data.frame(
    Variant   = "SVs",
    Category  = c("YPD.1 only", "YPD.2 only", "Shared"),
    Count     = c(sum(unified_sv$Category == "FLU.1_ONLY"),
                  sum(unified_sv$Category == "FLU.2_ONLY"),
                  sum(unified_sv$Category == "SHARED"))
  ),
  data.frame(
    Variant   = "All Variants",
    Category  = c("YPD.1 only", "YPD.2 only", "Shared"),
    Count     = c(sum(unified_all$Category == "FLU.1_ONLY"),
                  sum(unified_all$Category == "FLU.2_ONLY"),
                  sum(unified_all$Category == "SHARED"))
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Variant  = factor(Variant,  levels = c("SNPs", "CNVs", "InDels", "SVs", "All Variants")),
    Category = factor(Category, levels = c("YPD.1 only", "YPD.2 only", "Shared"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(Variant) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Variant = sum(Count),
    Pct           = (Count / Total_Variant) * 100,
    Label         = paste0(scales::comma(Count), "\n(", round(Pct, 1), "%)")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

overlap_colors <- c(
  "YPD.1 only" = "#E76F51",
  "YPD.2 only" = "#2196ac",
  "Shared"     = "#4CAF50"
)
```

# Part 8: Boxplot — Signal Strength by Category (All Variants)

```{r fig-boxplot, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
boxplot_data <- unified_all %>%
  mutate(
    neglog10p = case_when(
      Category == "SHARED"     ~ (FLU.1_neglog10p + FLU.2_neglog10p) / 2,
      Category == "FLU.1_ONLY"  ~ FLU.1_neglog10p,
      Category == "FLU.2_ONLY"  ~ FLU.2_neglog10p
    ),
    Category = factor(Category, levels = c("FLU.1_ONLY", "FLU.2_ONLY", "SHARED")),
    Variant  = factor(Variant, levels = c("SNPs", "CNVs", "InDels", "SVs"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(neglog10p))

summary_stats <- boxplot_data %>%
  group_by(Variant, Category) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median = median(neglog10p), .groups = "drop")

p_box <- ggplot(boxplot_data, aes(x = Category, y = neglog10p, 
                                   color = Category, fill = Category)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.15, width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.2, size = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = category_colors, labels = clean_labels) +
  scale_color_manual(values = category_colors, labels = clean_labels) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = clean_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.15))) +
  facet_wrap(~ Variant, nrow = 1) +
  labs(y = expression(-log[10](italic(p)-value)),
       title = "Signal strength (-log10 p-value) by category and variant type") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text         = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 11, angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin        = margin(14, 18, 20, 14)
  )

print(p_box)
```

# Part 9: Density Plots — p-values by Category (All Variants) WITH STAGGERED LABELS

```{r fig-density-pval}
build_density_plot <- function(plot_data, means_df, title) {
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = neglog10p_value, fill = Source, color = Source)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(data = means_df,
               aes(xintercept = median_val, color = Source),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_text(data = means_df,
              aes(x     = median_val,
                  y     = Inf,
                  label = paste0(clean_labels[Source], "\nmedian=", round(median_val, 2)),
                  color = Source,
                  vjust = c(1.3, 3.8, 6.3)),
              hjust = -0.07, size = 3.8, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = category_colors, labels = clean_labels) +
    scale_color_manual(values = category_colors, labels = clean_labels) +
    labs(x = expression(-log[10](italic(p)-value)), 
         y = "Density",
         title = title,
         fill = "Category", color = "Category") +
    shared_density_theme
}
```

```{r fig-scatter-pval, fig.width=14, fig.height=7}
make_scatter_pval <- function(ud, variant_label) {

  scatter_data <- ud %>%
    mutate(
      x_val    = if_else(is.na(FLU.2_neglog10p), 0, FLU.2_neglog10p),
      y_val    = if_else(is.na(FLU.1_neglog10p), 0, FLU.1_neglog10p),
      Category = factor(Category, levels = c("FLU.1_ONLY", "FLU.2_ONLY", "SHARED"))
    )

  ax_lim   <- max(c(scatter_data$x_val, scatter_data$y_val), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
  n_shared <- sum(scatter_data$Category == "SHARED")
  n_FLU.1   <- sum(scatter_data$Category == "FLU.1_ONLY")
  n_FLU.2   <- sum(scatter_data$Category == "FLU.2_ONLY")

  ggplot(scatter_data, aes(x = x_val, y = y_val, color = Category)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(data = scatter_data %>% filter(Category != "SHARED"),
               alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5) +
    geom_point(data = scatter_data %>% filter(Category == "SHARED"),
               alpha = 0.5, size = 1.8) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = category_colors,
      labels = c(
        "FLU.1_ONLY" = paste0("YPD.1 only (n=", n_FLU.1, ")"),
        "FLU.2_ONLY" = paste0("YPD.2 only (n=", n_FLU.2, ")"),
        "SHARED"    = paste0("Shared (n=", n_shared, ")")
      )
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = c(0, ax_lim), ylim = c(0, ax_lim)) +
    labs(
      title = variant_label,
      x     = expression(bold("YPD.2") ~ -log[10](italic(p)-value)),
      y     = expression(bold("YPD.1") ~ -log[10](italic(p)-value)),
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text       = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x    = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 6)),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 6)),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.margin     = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)
    )
}
```

# Part 12: Sign Concordance Analysis for All Variant Types

```{r sign-concordance-setup}
# Function to compute sign concordance metrics
compute_sign_concordance <- function(ud, variant_label) {
  
  # Filter shared eQTLs only
  shared <- ud %>% filter(Category == "SHARED") %>%
    filter(!is.na(FLU.1_SnpWeight) & !is.na(FLU.2_SnpWeight))
  
  if (nrow(shared) == 0) {
    cat("No shared eQTLs with both beta values for", variant_label, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Metrics
  n_total       <- nrow(shared)
  n_concordant  <- sum(sign(shared$FLU.1_SnpWeight) == sign(shared$FLU.2_SnpWeight), na.rm = TRUE)
  obs_sign_conc <- n_concordant / n_total
  obs_r         <- cor(shared$FLU.1_SnpWeight, shared$FLU.2_SnpWeight, 
                       method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
  
  # Binomial test
  binom_result <- binom.test(n_concordant, n_total, p = 0.5, alternative = "greater")
  
  # Permutation test
  set.seed(42)
  n_perm     <- 5000
  perm_sign  <- numeric(n_perm)
  perm_r     <- numeric(n_perm)
  
  b1 <- shared$FLU.1_SnpWeight
  b2 <- shared$FLU.2_SnpWeight
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_perm)) {
    b2_shuf      <- sample(b2)
    perm_sign[i] <- mean(sign(b1) == sign(b2_shuf))
    perm_r[i]    <- cor(b1, b2_shuf, method = "pearson")
  }
  
  perm_p_sign <- mean(perm_sign >= obs_sign_conc)
  perm_p_r    <- mean(perm_r >= obs_r)
  
  list(
    variant_label = variant_label,
    shared_data   = shared,
    n_total       = n_total,
    n_concordant  = n_concordant,
    obs_sign_conc = obs_sign_conc,
    obs_r         = obs_r,
    binom_result  = binom_result,
    perm_sign     = perm_sign,
    perm_r        = perm_r,
    perm_p_sign   = perm_p_sign,
    perm_p_r      = perm_p_r
  )
}

# Compute for all variants
sign_conc_snp   <- compute_sign_concordance(unified_snp,   "SNPs")
sign_conc_cnv   <- compute_sign_concordance(unified_cnv,   "CNVs")
sign_conc_indel <- compute_sign_concordance(unified_indel, "InDels")
sign_conc_sv    <- compute_sign_concordance(unified_sv,    "SVs")

cat("✓ Sign concordance metrics computed for all variant types\n\n")
```

```{r sign-conc-stats}
print_sign_concordance <- function(sc) {
  cat("\n", strrep("═", 60), "\n")
  cat(sc$variant_label, "\n")
  cat(strrep("═", 60), "\n")
  
  cat(sprintf("N shared eQTLs: %d\n", sc$n_total))
  cat(sprintf("Concordant: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
              sc$n_concordant, sc$n_total, sc$obs_sign_conc * 100))
  cat(sprintf("Pearson r: %.4f\n\n", sc$obs_r))
  
  cat("Binomial test (H0: concordance = 0.50):\n")
  cat(sprintf("  p-value: %.3e\n", sc$binom_result$p.value))
  cat(sprintf("  95%% CI: [%.3f, %.3f]\n\n",
              sc$binom_result$conf.int[1], sc$binom_result$conf.int[2]))
  
  cat(sprintf("Permutation test (n = 5000):\n"))
  cat(sprintf("  Sign concordance p-value: %.4f\n", sc$perm_p_sign))
  cat(sprintf("  Pearson r p-value:        %.4f\n", sc$perm_p_r))
}
```

```{r fig-null-distributions, fig.width=14, fig.height=7}
make_null_plot <- function(sc) {
  
  perm_df <- data.frame(
    sign_conc = sc$perm_sign,
    pearson_r = sc$perm_r
  )
  
  # Panel A: sign concordance
  p_null_sign <- ggplot(perm_df, aes(x = sign_conc)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "grey70", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = sc$obs_sign_conc, color = "#E74C3C", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dashed") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf,
             label = sprintf("Obs = %.3f\np = %.4f", sc$obs_sign_conc, sc$perm_p_sign),
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
    labs(title = paste(sc$variant_label, "- Sign Concordance"),
         x = "Sign concordance", y = "Count") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
  
  # Panel B: Pearson r
  p_null_r <- ggplot(perm_df, aes(x = pearson_r)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "grey70", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = sc$obs_r, color = "#27AE60", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dashed") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf,
             label = sprintf("Obs = %.3f\np = %.4f", sc$obs_r, sc$perm_p_r),
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
    labs(title = paste(sc$variant_label, "- Pearson r"),
         x = "Pearson r", y = "Count") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
  
  gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_null_sign, p_null_r, nrow = 1)
}
```

```{r retrieve-concordance-data}
# Function to retrieve YPD.1 significant variants and their YPD.2 values
retrieve_concordance_data <- function(FLU.1_signif, variant_type, dir_FLU.1, dir_FLU.2) {
  
  cat(sprintf("Processing %s...\n", variant_type))
  
  # Use correct column name for genes
  FLU.1_genes <- unique(FLU.1_signif$Source_Phenotype)
  cat(sprintf("  Unique genes in YPD.1: %d\n", length(FLU.1_genes)))
  
  FLU.2_lookup <- lapply(seq_along(FLU.1_genes), function(i) {
    
    gene <- FLU.1_genes[i]
    path_FLU.2 <- file.path(dir_FLU.2, gene, paste0(gene, ".first_assoc.txt"))
    
    # Progress log every 50 genes
    if (i %% 50 == 0) {
      cat(sprintf("    [%d/%d done] last gene: %s\n",
                  i, length(FLU.1_genes), gene))
    }
    
    # Skip if file doesn't exist in YPD.2
    if (!file.exists(path_FLU.2)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Variants significant in YPD.1 for this gene
    FLU.1_vars <- FLU.1_signif %>% 
      filter(Source_Phenotype == gene) %>% 
      select(SNP, Beta_FLU.1 = SnpWeight, P_FLU.1 = PValue)
    
    if (nrow(FLU.1_vars) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Full YPD.2 results for this gene
    FLU.2 <- read.table(path_FLU.2, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", 
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE, quote = "") %>%
      select(SNP, Beta_FLU.2 = SnpWeight, P_FLU.2 = PValue)
    
    # Join — keep only YPD.1 significant variants, get YPD.2 values for them
    inner_join(FLU.1_vars, FLU.2, by = "SNP") %>%
      mutate(Gene = gene, Variant_Type = variant_type)
    
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  cat(sprintf("  Total variant×gene pairs retrieved: %d\n", nrow(FLU.2_lookup)))
  cat(sprintf("  Genes with YPD.2 data found: %d\n\n", n_distinct(FLU.2_lookup$Gene)))
  
  return(FLU.2_lookup)
}

# Retrieve concordance data for all variant types
```

```{r concordance-statistics}
# Calculate concordance metrics for each variant type
calculate_concordance_stats <- function(conc_data, variant_label) {
  
  # Remove missing values
  complete_data <- conc_data %>% 
    filter(!is.na(Beta_FLU.1) & !is.na(Beta_FLU.2))
  
  n_total       <- nrow(complete_data)
  n_concordant  <- sum(sign(complete_data$Beta_FLU.1) == sign(complete_data$Beta_FLU.2), 
                       na.rm = TRUE)
  obs_sign_conc <- n_concordant / n_total
  obs_r         <- cor(complete_data$Beta_FLU.1, complete_data$Beta_FLU.2, 
                       method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
  
  # Binomial test
  binom_result <- binom.test(n_concordant, n_total, p = 0.5, alternative = "greater")
  
  # Permutation test
  set.seed(42)
  n_perm     <- 5000
  perm_sign  <- numeric(n_perm)
  perm_r     <- numeric(n_perm)
  
  b1 <- complete_data$Beta_FLU.1
  b2 <- complete_data$Beta_FLU.2
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_perm)) {
    b2_shuf      <- sample(b2)
    perm_sign[i] <- mean(sign(b1) == sign(b2_shuf))
    perm_r[i]    <- cor(b1, b2_shuf, method = "pearson")
  }
  
  perm_p_sign <- mean(perm_sign >= obs_sign_conc)
  perm_p_r    <- mean(perm_r >= obs_r)
  
    # Print summary
  cat("\n", strrep("═", 60), "\n")
  cat(variant_label, "\n")
  cat(strrep("═", 60), "\n")
  cat(sprintf("N eQTLs: %d\n", n_total))
  cat(sprintf("Concordant: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n", n_concordant, n_total, obs_sign_conc * 100))
  cat(sprintf("Pearson r: %.4f\n\n", obs_r))
  cat(sprintf("Binomial test (H0: concordance = 0.50)\n"))
  cat(sprintf("  p-value: %.3e\n", binom_result$p.value))
  cat(sprintf("  95%% CI: [%.3f, %.3f]\n\n",
              binom_result$conf.int[1], binom_result$conf.int[2]))
  cat(sprintf("Permutation test (n = 5000)\n"))
  cat(sprintf("  Sign concordance p-value: %.4f\n", perm_p_sign))
  cat(sprintf("  Pearson r p-value:        %.4f\n\n", perm_p_r))
  
  list(
    variant_label = variant_label,
    data          = complete_data,
    n_total       = n_total,
    n_concordant  = n_concordant,
    obs_sign_conc = obs_sign_conc,
    obs_r         = obs_r,
    binom_result  = binom_result,
    perm_sign     = perm_sign,
    perm_r        = perm_r,
    perm_p_sign   = perm_p_sign,
    perm_p_r      = perm_p_r
  )
}

# Calculate for all variant types
conc_snp   <- calculate_concordance_stats(concordance_snp,   "SNPs")
conc_cnv   <- calculate_concordance_stats(concordance_cnv,   "CNVs")
conc_indel <- calculate_concordance_stats(concordance_indel, "InDels")
conc_sv    <- calculate_concordance_stats(concordance_sv,    "SVs")

cat("✓ Concordance statistics calculated\n\n")
```

```{r concordance-null-distributions, fig.width=14, fig.height=7}
    labs(title = sprintf("%s - Sign Concordance", conc$variant_label),
         x = "Sign concordance", y = "Count") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
  
  # Panel B: Pearson r
  p_null_r <- ggplot(perm_df, aes(x = pearson_r)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "grey70", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = conc$obs_r, color = "#27AE60", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dashed") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf,
             label = sprintf("Obs = %.3f\np = %.4f", conc$obs_r, conc$perm_p_r),
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.8, fontface = "bold") +
    labs(title = sprintf("%s - Pearson r", conc$variant_label),
         x = "Pearson r", y = "Count") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
  
  gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_null_sign, p_null_r, nrow = 1)
}

p_null_snp   <- make_concordance_null_plot(conc_snp)
p_null_cnv   <- make_concordance_null_plot(conc_cnv)
p_null_indel <- make_concordance_null_plot(conc_indel)
p_null_sv    <- make_concordance_null_plot(conc_sv)

print(p_null_snp)

       p_null_snp, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

# Part 20: Detection Rate Summary

``` {r detection-rate-summary}
# Calculate detection rates
calculate_detection_rate <- function(conc_data, all_FLU.1_data, variant_label) {
  
  n_FLU.1_total <- nrow(all_FLU.1_data)
  n_detected <- nrow(conc_data)
  detection_rate <- (n_detected / n_FLU.1_total) * 100
  
  list(
    Variant_Type = variant_label,
    FLU.1_Total = n_FLU.1_total,
    Found_in_FLU.2 = n_detected,
    Detection_Rate_Pct = detection_rate,
    Not_Found = n_FLU.1_total - n_detected
  )
}

detection_rates <- bind_rows(
  calculate_detection_rate(concordance_snp, all_snps_eqtl_FLU.1, "SNPs"),
  calculate_detection_rate(concordance_cnv, all_CNV_eqtl_FLU.1, "CNVs"),
  calculate_detection_rate(concordance_indel, all_indel_eqtl_FLU.1, "InDels"),
  calculate_detection_rate(concordance_sv, all_SV_eqtl_FLU.1, "SVs")
) %>%
  mutate(across(Detection_Rate_Pct, ~round(., 2)))

cat("\n")
cat("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DETECTION RATE: YPD.1 eQTLs found in YPD.2\n")
cat("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
print(detection_rates)

write.csv(detection_rates,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Detection_Rate_Summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n✓ Saved: Detection_Rate_Summary.csv\n")

# Overall statistics
cat("\nOVERALL:\n")
cat(sprintf("Total YPD.1 eQTLs: %d\n", sum(detection_rates$FLU.1_Total)))
cat(sprintf("Found in YPD.2: %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
            sum(detection_rates$Found_in_FLU.2),
            (sum(detection_rates$Found_in_FLU.2) / sum(detection_rates$FLU.1_Total)) * 100))
cat(sprintf("Not found in YPD.2: %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
            sum(detection_rates$Not_Found),
            (sum(detection_rates$Not_Found) / sum(detection_rates$FLU.1_Total)) * 100))
```

# Part 19: Save All Shared eQTLs to CSV Files

``` {r save-shared-eqtls}
# Helper function to extract and save shared eQTLs
save_shared_eqtls <- function(unified_df, variant_label, output_dir) {
  
  # Filter for shared eQTLs only
  shared_df <- unified_df %>% filter(Category == "SHARED")
  
  if (nrow(shared_df) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("%s: No shared eQTLs found\n", variant_label))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create separate rows for YPD.1 and YPD.2
  shared_FLU.1 <- shared_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Chr, ChrPos, Pheno,
      Beta = FLU.1_SnpWeight,
      PValue = FLU.1_neglog10p,
      Threshold = FLU.1_thr_neglog10p,
      Distance_Above_Threshold = FLU.1_distance_above_thr
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Source = "YPD.1",
      Variant_Type = variant_label,
      .before = Beta
    )
  
  shared_FLU.2 <- shared_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Chr, ChrPos, Pheno,
      Beta = FLU.2_SnpWeight,
      PValue = FLU.2_neglog10p,
      Threshold = FLU.2_thr_neglog10p,
      Distance_Above_Threshold = FLU.2_distance_above_thr
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Source = "YPD.2",
      Variant_Type = variant_label,
      .before = Beta
    )
  
  # Combine both sources
  combined <- bind_rows(shared_FLU.1, shared_FLU.2) %>%
    arrange(Pheno, Chr, ChrPos, Source)
  
  # Save to file
  filename <- file.path(output_dir, 
                        paste0("shared_eQTLs_FLU.1_vs_FLU.2_", variant_label, ".csv"))
  write.csv(combined, filename, row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat(sprintf("%s: Saved %d associations (%d unique) to %s\n",
              variant_label, nrow(combined), nrow(shared_df), 
              basename(filename)))
  
  invisible(combined)
}

# Save shared eQTLs for each variant type
shared_snp_df   <- save_shared_eqtls(unified_snp,   "SNPs",   OUTPUT_DIR)
shared_cnv_df   <- save_shared_eqtls(unified_cnv,   "CNVs",   OUTPUT_DIR)
shared_indel_df <- save_shared_eqtls(unified_indel, "InDels", OUTPUT_DIR)
shared_sv_df    <- save_shared_eqtls(unified_sv,    "SVs",    OUTPUT_DIR)

cat("\n")
```

✅ **Extracts all SHARED eQTLs** from each unified dataframe

✅ **Includes all relevant columns**: Chr, ChrPos, Pheno (gene), Beta, p-value, threshold, distance above threshold  
✅ **Sorts by gene and position** for easy browsing  
✅ **Saves per variant type** (SNPs, CNVs, InDels, SVs)  
✅ **Saves combined file** with all variant types together  
✅ **Prints summary statistics** showing breakdown by variant type  

**Output files:**
